FOUR RECORDS, EACH READ WHOLE; THE SYNTHESIS IS RIGHT ON THREE LEGS AND OVERSTATED ON ONE.

(1) THE DEFERRAL SWEEP — §764.4/§764.5 (docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md:31703–31704). The owner's words: "So nothing emergent should ever be delayed or deferred for after launch" (§764.4), ratified "The only exception is anything related to the settlement layer map module(s) which we've already noted" (§764.5, "No longer vetoable-pending: this is the owner's direct word"). The order names the deliverable exactly: "the deferral ledgers get swept for launch-path members at the residue stage and each is either scheduled into §764.3's arc or brought to the owner by name." §765.2 (ODQ:31709) schedules it: "CH-6b … the chair mints-or-drops it at the residue sweep with the deferral-ledger pass (§764.4)."
⚠ CORRECTION TO THE SYNTHESIS: the sweep was NOT "never run." It ran once, as lane M1a on 2026-09-01, enrolled at docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md:980–1010 ("§877.2 · THE M1a DEFERRAL SWEEP — the denominator measured by class") with eight recorded judgment calls J-M1A-1…8. But THREE facts about that run keep the item open, and all three are in the record:
 (a) ITS SCOPE WAS DELIBERATELY NARROWED. J-M1A-7 (retro queue :1000): "the `docs/**` prose layer ruled **out of scope** for the sweep and recorded as a deliberate deferral." The docs half of the launch-path deferral sweep has never been run.
 (b) ITS ARTIFACT IS GONE. The receipts line cites `$SP/M1A-DEFERRAL-SWEEP.md` §§1–7 and `$SP/laneM1A-receipt.md` §2 (22 rows) — scratchpad paths. CONFIRMED absent today: not in `git ls-files`, not in any of the 380 `refs/preserve/*` trees, not on disk anywhere under /private/tmp/claude-502. The ledger's own §877.2 (ODQ:32289) records the lane's code-level outcomes but carries NO list of the 12 launch-path rows. The sweep's inventory does not survive; only its author's eight judgment calls do.
 (c) ITS CENTRAL CALL IS ENROLLED AND UNRULED. Retro queue :1003–1005 asks Fable to re-derive "That the EMERGENT/SCOPE-BOUNDARY split (J-M1A-1) is the right reading of §764.4 — and that the 12 named emergent rows are the right 12." No *RULED* marker follows that row.
 Also live and untested against §764.5: ODQ §877.2 records "RULED: **the wiring car is PARKED to a post-launch packet**" — a post-launch parking that is lawful only if the car is scope-boundary, not emergent.

(2) THREE COPIES OF ONE QUEUE — §883.5(c) (docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md:2251–2259). The chair found three candidate sources for docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md that `chair-commit.sh` "maps by whichever path it is handed, silently and without comparison": the ledger worktree copy (1,410 lines / 152,041 B, staged-deleted-plus-untracked, STALE BY 770 LINES), the previous kit copy (2,118 lines / 300,067 B, stale by 62), and `git show HEAD:…` (2,180 lines / 319,498 B, the only authoritative one). "⚠ Appending to (1) would have landed a commit that silently DELETED four strata while passing every gate this program owns." Priority "⛔ HIGH — this is a live structural gap, not a judgment call." The named cure: "refuse any mapped docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md whose source does not CONTAIN the parent blob's content as a prefix."
 STATE: §892's ruling (same file, :2265) reads "**(c) RATIFIED and the gap is still OPEN (S11)** … ⛔ **the prefix gate is STILL NOT INSTALLED in any copy of `chair-commit.sh`** — the ledger worktree's steady state today shows both append-only files as staged-deleted-plus-untracked, so the hand procedure … remains the only protection." That verdict is still exact today (see State of code).

(3) A LEDGER SECTION NEVER WRITTEN — §685.5(vi) (ODQ:28618–28625): "**A LEDGER HOLE, FOUND AND CONFIRMED: §683 HAS NO ODQ SECTION.** Commit `bc907c3ad` … touched DESIGN_SPINE_COMPLETION, the handoff, OWNER_DOCKET and SIGNED_CONSTANTS — **and not the ledger**; the ODQ jumps §682 → §684. The rulings themselves are safe (their home is the PANEL AMENDMENT …), but every '§683' citation points at a section that does not exist. Under the append-only law it is **NOT retro-inserted**: recorded here, with the amendment standing as the authoritative home."

(4) A 245-SECTION SPAN NO SWEEP HAS READ — §693.9 (ODQ:29258–29266): "**§440–§684 as a body — 245 sections, the single largest unexamined surface**, filed P3 'recovered-not-marked' on **trailer evidence alone**; no sweep read it. The **sealed namespaces** `refs/trains/*` (31) and `refs/preserved/*` (3), which any sweep scoped to `refs/preserve/` misses entirely. **SILENT RE-DERIVATIONS** … The **document estate outside the two queues**. And **whether the sitting's ratifications independently carry themselves** — that check was run on §298.1(b) and on nothing else."
 STATE: STILL OPEN. The register row at retro queue :139 is unchanged ("| **§440–§684** | **RECOVERED-NOT-MARKED** | … | P3 |"), and the retro queue's §693 row (:760–774) still reads "*Priority:* **P1** on (a) and (c)" with NO *RULED* marker — the §879 and §892 sittings ruled slices S01 and S10–S18 over the §87x–§89x era and never reached the span.

ADJACENT, RECORD-NAMED, NOT INVENTED: the retro queue's register (:141) also carries "⛔ docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md | **A SECOND, OLDER QUEUE — LARGELY UNRULED** | The 2026-07-31 asking's own register: 883,766 B, **151 data rows, of which 147 carry no status marker**."
